title: The Fizzler
excerpt: Ask a model anything and it reaches for the answer everyone else gets. The Fizzler hands it something from outside the box first.
content_html:
Escape defaultthink

Ask a model anything and it reaches for the answer everyone else gets. The Fizzler hands it something from outside the box first.

  1. 01Your agent asks.

  2. 02The Fizzler hands back a few fizzles.

  3. 03The agent picks one or two.

  4. 04It lands somewhere new.

What comes back

Fizzles

Real things from other worlds.

A work, a person, a technique, an event. A beekeeping manual. A ship's log. A film. An expired patent.

Your agent takes the one or two that surprise it and looks at your problem from there. How would this person go at it? What would your problem be if it worked like this thing?

Give it to your agent

One note tells your agent how to add the Fizzler and when to use it. No key needed.

Or add it by hand as an MCP server:

https://fizzler.ai/mcp

Think you have a fizzle?

A person reads every one before anything goes in.
